call_points.text: FY27 acquired-group guidance kept at €700 Mn sales and €35 Mn EBITDA despite a strong Q1; to be revisited after Q2.
The €90-100 Mn EBITDA target over 3-4 years is unchanged and was set on day one.
No new volume capex needed; only moderate spending on backward integration or special projects if returns justify it.
Management plans to accelerate repayment of the acquisition debt as net debt improves.
Price increases have only passed through cost inflation; management would reverse some pricing if raw material and oil prices soften.
Management expects to achieve EUR 90 million to 100 million EBITDA over the next 3 to 4 years.
Expected EBITDA of EUR 35 million for the acquired group for the next financial year.
Energy costs constitute around 6% to 7% of revenue in the global business.
Global pigment industry growth generally tracks GDP, varying between 3% to 4% globally.
Management expects to achieve EBITDA of €90-100 Mn over 3-4 years for the Acquired Group as guided at the time of acquisition.
Destocking on legacy Heubach products is easing with global accounts buying more in January and early February.
Net debt reduced from ₹934 Cr in December 2025 to ₹755 Cr at March 2026.
SAP integration moving from 4 to one integrated system is well underway with a fully harmonized landscape expected by December 2026.

The Company made the payment of fine imposed by BSE within the timelines prescribed by BSE.
penalties.impact: The Company had applied to the Stock Exchanges for grant of an extension for submission of the unaudited financial results for the quarter ended 30th June, 2025 as per SEBI Listing Regulations, 2015 and an intimation was also given to the public at large on 13th August, 2025. The said delay was on account of the cascading effect of delay in submission of audited financial results for the quarter and year ended 31st March, 2025. There was no impact on the financial, operation or other activities of the Company due to levy of the said fine. Further, the Company submitted unaudited financial results for the quarter ended 30 June 2025 on 23 September 2025.
